preJoin.screenShareUnsupported: Bu brauzer ekran ulashishni qo'llamaydi — boshqa brauzerdan urinib ko'ring.
preJoin.screenShareNoAudio: Ekran tovushi ulanmadi — ochilgan oynada "Tovushni ham ulashish" (Share audio / Share tab audio) belgisini albatta yoqing. Qayta urinib ko'ring.
preJoin.screenSharePermissionDenied: Ekran ulashishga ruxsat berilmadi — dars video yozuvi uchun bu shart. Qayta urinib ko'ring.
preJoin.deviceErrorMessage: Qurilmaga ulanib bo'lmadi: {{error}}. Brauzer ruxsatini tekshiring.
preJoin.micTokenMissing: Server tokenida mikrofon ruxsati yo'q — darsda gapira olmaysiz. Bu kutilmagan holat, texnik jamoaga xabar bering.
preJoin.teacherScreenShareNote: Dars <0>yozib olinishi</0> va o'quvchilarga <1>jonli ko'rsatilishi</1> uchun brauzer ekran ulashishni so'raydi — ochilgan oynada istalgan bo'limni (masalan "Chrome tab") tanlang va <2>"Tovushni ham ulashish"</2> (Share audio) belgisini <3>albatta yoqing</3> — aks holda ekrandagi tovush (masalan video/musiqa) na o'quvchilarga, na yozuvga tushmaydi. Darsga kirishning o'zida yozuv HAM, o'quvchilarga ko'rsatish HAM darhol boshlanadi — qayta tugma bosish shart emas. Ruxsat berilmasa yoki tovush ulanmasa, darsga kira olmaysiz — qayta urinib ko'rasiz.
preJoin.canChangeLater: Darsga kirgandan keyin ham o'zgartirishingiz mumkin.
preJoin.needPermission: Darsda gapirish uchun o'qituvchidan ruxsat so'raysiz.

preJoin.recordingNoteStudent: Dars yozib olinadi — keyin “Dars yozuvi” bo‘limida ko‘rishingiz mumkin.
